title: EUR/USD Seasonality: Why December Has Historically Been a Strong Month for the Euro
summary: While foreign exchange markets are largely driven by monetary policy, interest rate differentials, economic growth and geopolitical developments, historical data suggests that certain currency pairs also exhibit recurring seasonal patterns that can provide investors and traders with an additional perspective when evaluating market opportunities.
